owner: Creator operational authorization; CRM owns Account/Contact relationship facts
registryChoice: Separate operator-only Creator forms; no portal CRUD or reports

fields.Principal_ID: required immutable text; independently assigned internal human principal
fields.Audit_Actor_ID: required immutable text; reviewed human audit identity
fields.Native_Subject_ID: required immutable exact text for this principal; qualified native account identity, not email or username
fields.Incarnation_ID: required immutable exact text for this principal; authoritative lifecycle evidence, not operator timestamp inferred from email
fields.Email_Lookup: required exact reviewed email; lookup only, no normalization or automatic reassignment
fields.Native_Username: required exact reviewed text; corroboration only
fields.Active: required Boolean; false blocks all associated operation grants

Portal_Principal_Bindings.lifecycle: Keep inactive tombstones; recreated account gets a new internal principal only after reviewed provisioning. No same-email inheritance. A changed email requires revoke, review and controlled rebind; never a user-editable field.

Portal_Operation_Grants.lifecycle: Every binding rebind, incarnation transition or authorization change revokes prior grants and assigns new grant revisions before reactivation. Provisioning must serialize these changes or leave the binding inactive. Atomic durable acceptance remains a separate gate.

fields.CRM_Account_ID: required exact reviewed CRM Accounts ID

fields.CRM_Contact_ID: required exact reviewed CRM Contacts ID

Portal_Contact_Links.join: Creator contact belongs to selected Creator Account; current CRM Contacts.Account_Name.id must equal linked CRM Account

reader.candidate: OAuth Custom API, Portal users scope, widget invocation only; function derives caller context, never caller-supplied identity arguments
unavailableNativeFacts: proven current caller context in widget-to-Custom-API execution
reader.scopeEvidence: Pinned environment/organization and server-clock observation; native current permission must match protected allowlist
reader.completeness: Read all candidates for email, native subject and internal principal, including inactive rows; duplicates never resolved by active/latest ordering. Global reverse canonical-link uniqueness must be established, not merely selected-company filtering.
reader.output: Exact existing protected authorization snapshot; no email, username, native permission or lifecycle values returned to client

constraints: Proposed names/types only. Native uniqueness, concurrent provisioning, restricted report/API access, permissions and lifecycle hooks need separately approved metadata/configuration and qualification. Existing Portal_Test_ResolveCompany stays fixture-only. No provisioning, deployment or migration is authorized.
